passages:
Jack: Sweet heart! Why are you in a hurry?
Nina: Oh, please. Jack! Not now!
Jack: Where are you going?
Nina: (runs out of the house and jumps into the car) Talk to you later!!!
(Two hours later)
Nina: J~A~C~K! Come pick up these big bags and heavy boxes! Mommy’s Help is having a big sale toady, and I went shopping there.
Jack: Oh my! Did you just move the entire store home?
Nina: Come on! We need all these things.
Jack: All right! Let me take a look. Five pairs of jeans? Seriously? Why do we need so many? And do you really think we need... 24 toothbrushes? 15 packs of cookies? And look at this! A coffee maker? Didn’t we just get one two months ago? And you don’t even love coffee!
Nina: Oh please! This one is different from the old one. It’s from Japan, and the salesperson told me that every family should have one...
Jack: Wait! A salesperson? Well, did he also tell you that this is the last one, and if you don’t buy it today, you will feel sorry later?
Nina: Yes!!! How did you know?
Jack: You are falling for the tricks of “hungry marketing.” Businesses often use it to make people suddenly feel the strong need to buy things. They will say something to make you feel bad for not buying. This way, they push you to spend money and at last get all the money in your pocket!
Nina: Oh no! Then what should I do?
Jack: Be a smart shopper! Don’t lose your mind and shop like crazy. Always look before you leap!

(entire 整個的　coffee maker 咖啡機　suddenly 突然地)

【Zac】August 20, 2024
You all know that I am traveling around the USA. A few days ago, I happened to see a place with a special name “Hot Coffee” on Google map. I wanted to know more about it, so I went there. To my surprise, it is a very small place, with only a few houses and stores. Before I went there, I googled it and knew that it got the name in 1870 because people could buy hot coffee there. So I went to one store and got myself a cup of coffee. Well, it tasted quite... common! Haha! I also collected some interesting place names in the USA as below. Do you know any interesting one around the world? Share it with me!
One Mile (Arizona)｜Two Egg (Florida)｜Three Rivers (Michigan)｜Four Holes (South Carolina)｜Five Points (Kansas)
Six Lakes (Michigan)｜Seven Devils (North Carolina)｜Eight Corners (Wisconsin)｜Nine Times (South Carolina)｜Ten Sleep (Wyoming)

【Wendy】In my country Taiwan, one of my friends lives in “Dream.” Every time I visit her, I have to take the bus to “Dream.”

(google 搜尋　hole 洞　devil 惡魔)

In a world of songs so sweet and clear,
I dance with joy to the sound only — I hold it ever so dear.
In the quiet and magic moments, my special song,
A different sound guiding me comfortably along.

Life breaks out to be pieces of experiences here and there,
In my own way, little by little I learn to show how much I care.
Colors break out like bright stars in my mind,
A beautiful kaleidoscope of ideas, one of a kind.

Red, blue and yellow looking so bright,
I find hope in the quiet of the night.
With each lazy walk, finding my very own way,
Bright stars of hope light up my every day.

Through the bright colors, I find my way,
In the dance of life, how happily I play.
With a heart full of hope and a song so clear,
I’ll keep dancing on in this world — I warmly hold it so dear.

(guide 指引　kaleidoscope 萬花筒　poem 詩　title 標題)

Sophia’s Corner
　　Do you know the following Chinese idiom? 「學富五車」
　　Yes, it means someone has a lot of knowledge. He or she reads a lot of books, and those books can fill up five carriages. And you may want to know: How many books are there in five carriages?
　　This Chinese idiom is from about two thousand years ago. At that time, people “wrote” books, not “printed” them. And we all know that there was no writing paper then, so what did they use to write on? The answer is bamboo slips. Look at the picture below.
（附圖：一卷竹簡。Thin ropes tie the slips together. 每片竹簡長約 30 cm、寬約 1 cm、厚約 0.2 cm）
　　There is usually one line of words on one slip. A roll of bamboo slips is thick, but there are not many words. If we put all the words on the slips on the paper today, it would become a thin book. Five carriages of books at that time may not fill up one big box on your desk today. So everyone, study hard! It is quite easy to be more than “學富五車,” isn’t it?

(idiom 成語　print 印　bamboo slip 竹簡　website 網站)

Clouds may look light and soft, but clouds are in fact not as light as they look. To find out how heavy a cloud is, we can’t just put it on a tool. We have to know its size and density.
　　The picture below shows B’s density is higher than A’s. Different types of clouds have different densities. For example, cumulus clouds have a lot of water inside them. Another type is the cumulonimbus cloud. These clouds usually look darker and have a lot more water. Cirrus clouds are thin. We mostly see them on sunny days. The more water a cloud has, the higher density it has.
（附圖：A、B 兩個方塊，B 內的小圓點比 A 多且密）
　　Secondly, we can know the size of a cloud by driving a car across its shadow when the sun is right above it. After getting the size and density of a cloud, we can use math to know how heavy it is.
　　It turns out that clouds are really heavy! A cumulus cloud is about 1.1 million pounds. It is like 100 elephants fly around above your head! Clouds are millions of small drops of water. The water in a cloud is not as heavy as the air around it. The air is much heavier, so it holds up the small drops of water. That’s why clouds can stay up in the sky.

(soft 軟的　density 密度　shadow 影子)

HNN News　10/21/2023
　　Sean, a 14-year-old teenager, didn’t go to fast food restaurants or libraries to study like what his classmates usually did after school. He went straight home because his sick mother was waiting for him to look after her. Last year, his mother got seriously sick. His two high school sisters stopped going to school; they went to work to make money to pay for the medical cost. So, it’s Sean’s job to look after their mother. He didn’t know what to do with this big change in life.
　　Teenagers like Sean are young carers. They are still young, but they need to have a strong mind. They can’t study or sleep well, and they can’t go out with friends. In other words, they don’t have their own young life. This also has bad effects on their life when they grow up. They may not do well at work or get along well with others.
　　The young carers may lead to many problems, so the government should give help in time.
（附圖：The number of young carers 長條圖，比較 USA、Australia、UK 三國）

(medical 醫療的　young carer 年輕照顧者　government 政府)

There were three soldiers in an army. They were too old, so the officer decided to get them retired by paying them. They could ＿41＿, and they would get US$1,000 for every inch in between.
　　The first soldier was tall and picked the top of his head and the bottom of his feet. Then he took his US$78,000 and went on his way happily. The second soldier picked ＿42＿. He stood on his tiptoes and reached his arm up over his head. After a few minutes, he was on his way with US$102,000.
　　The third soldier thought for a while, and then he smiled and said he would pick his left big toe and his right big toe. He took off his shoes and the officer cried out, “Oh my god! ＿43＿”
　　The soldier answered, “It’s in Japan.”

(army 軍隊　retire 退休　tiptoe 腳尖)

questions.q: Linda and her family go to work in different ways. How does her husband go to work?
questions.e: 由圖得知 Linda 的丈夫騎小型摩托車上班，選(D)。(A)開車(B)騎腳踏車(C)搭公車(D)騎小型摩托車。

questions.q: When the movie star took a walk in this small town, he was glad to find that he was a(n) ＿＿＿＿ to everyone. He finally could enjoy a quiet holiday.
questions.e: 當這位電影明星在這座小鎮散步時，他很高興發現他對每個人來說都是「陌生人」。他終於可以享受一個安靜的假期。(A)演員(B)外國人(C)成員(D)陌生人。

questions.q: Kelly ＿＿＿＿ shops for clothes on the Net. It is not possible for her to buy any clothes without trying them on first.
questions.e: Kelly「從不」在網路上買衣服。她不可能沒試穿就買衣服，選(A)。(A)從不(B)甚至(C)幾乎(D)經常。

questions.q: Jimmy has a serious sore throat, ＿＿＿＿ her mom won’t prepare anything too hot or too cold for him.
questions.e: Jimmy 喉嚨很痛，所以他的媽媽不為他準備太燙或太冰冷的食物，表示結果用 so，選(A)。

questions.q: Helen knows a lot about the art museums in Italy because she ＿＿＿＿ there for eight years. She came back to Taiwan in 2022.
questions.e: Helen 在 2022 年回到臺灣之前在義大利求學 8 年，過去時間的事實用過去簡單式表達，選(B)。

questions.q:
Mr. Lee: It’s getting dark. We’re going home in five minutes. Take all your things away. Don’t ＿＿＿＿ anything here, even the trash.
Students: Yes, sir.
questions.e: Mr. Lee 請學生帶走所有的東西，不要「留下」任何東西，選(A)。(A)留下(B)舉高(C)搖晃(D)攜帶。

questions.q: You should thank these people for many ＿＿＿＿. For example, they help you go through difficult times. They also raise money for you to finish school.
questions.e: 你應該因為很多「原因」感謝這些人。例如，他們幫助你度過難關。他們也募資幫助你完成學業，選(B)。(A)觀點(B)原因(C)服務(D)主題。

questions.q: The pork steak is too ＿＿＿＿ for me. My teeth are weak. Please cut it into small pieces. So, I can bite them easily.
questions.e: 豬排對我來說太「厚」了。我的牙齒不太堅固。請把它切成小塊。這樣我才能輕易咀嚼，選(D)。(A)美味的(B)免費的(C)甜的(D)厚的。

questions.q: Painting the walls might be tiring, but seeing the beautiful walls ＿＿＿＿ me forget about the hard work.
questions.e: 看到漂亮的牆壁令我忘卻辛苦，主詞 seeing the beautiful walls 指一件事，後接單數動詞，故選(B) makes。

questions.q: Sir, your car is in my way. I cannot drive ＿＿＿＿ out of the drive. Could you please move your car a few feet?
questions.e: 先生，你的車子擋住去路了。我無法把「我的車子」開出車道。可以請你移動車子幾呎嗎？以 mine 代替 my car，故選(C)。

questions.q:
Cindy: Good evening, Mr. White. Today we have tomato soup and pumpkin soup. ＿＿＿＿ would you like?
Mr. White: I don’t need soup today. Please give me cold milk tea.
questions.e: Cindy 問 Mr. White 今天有番茄湯和南瓜湯。他想要「哪一個」？有兩個選項，挑選其中之一，應使用 Which，選(D)。What 詢問開放性、沒指定選項的事物。

questions.q: The prices of the houses with two or three bedrooms in this area are getting too high for young people. ＿＿＿＿ of them are able to buy one.
questions.e: 這個地區 2～3 房的房價太高，「很少」年輕人買得起，選(B)。(A) little 修飾不可數名詞，(C)(D)選項均為正向敘述，與文意不符。

questions.q: I didn’t ＿＿＿＿ to see Mr. Wu and Ms. Hong, two of my teachers, at this fast food restaurant. And to my surprise, they were dating each other.
questions.e: 我沒有「預期」在速食店會看到我的二位老師 Mr. Wu 和 Ms. Hong。且令我意外的是，他們二人竟然在約會，選(D)。(A)同意(B)出現(C)相信(D)預期。

questions.q: Of all my teachers, I like Ms. Lee ＿＿＿＿ because she never gets angry every time I forget to hand in my homework.
questions.e: 忘記繳交作業，Ms. Lee 也不生氣，在所有老師中我「最」喜歡她，三者以上使用最高級，故選(D)。

questions.q: Linda lives with her family in a small apartment. They ＿＿＿＿ to their new apartment in two weeks.
questions.e: Linda 一家人在二週後就將搬入新家，未來時間的來去動詞以現在進行式表示未來即將進行的動作，推知選(C)。

questions.q: Don’t worry! The water is only knee-deep in the river, so your dog can get across it ＿＿＿＿.
questions.e: 別擔心！水只有及膝深，所以你的狗能「輕易地」過河，選(B)。(A)明亮地(B)輕易地(C)懶散地(D)大聲地。

questions.q: Did Jerry ＿＿＿＿ you anything for looking after his cat when he took a trip to London last month? Just saying “thank you” is not enough.
questions.e: Jerry 有「付錢」給你在他上個月去倫敦旅行時照顧他的貓嗎？只有道謝是不夠的，選(A)。(A)付錢給…(B)人花費時間或金錢(C)事物價值多少金錢(D)事物花費時間。

questions.q: I lost the ＿＿＿＿ of my bottle. How can I keep it in my bag? There is still a lot of water in it.
questions.e: 我弄丟了瓶子的「蓋子」。我要怎麼放在袋子裡？裡面還有很多水啊，選(B)。(A)底部(B)蓋子(C)遮蓋物(D)邊。

questions.q: Mrs. Yang is unhappy that her son didn’t clean his room this morning. She ＿＿＿＿ him to finish doing it in one hour, or he can’t go to the movies.
questions.e: Mrs. Yang 不開心她兒子今天早上沒有整理房間。她「告訴」他要在一小時內完成，否則不能看電影，選(C)。(A)的受詞補語為原形動詞(B)語意不合情境(D)的受詞補語為 V 或 V-ing。

questions.q: Kids, please don’t run around and be quiet. Everyone has a chance to play on the swing, but you have to ＿＿＿＿. Now please line up, and each will have five minutes.
questions.e: 孩子們，別跑來跑去請安靜。每個人都有機會玩鞦韆，但你們必須「輪流」。現在請排隊，然後每個人會有五分鐘，選(C)。(A)走開(B)站起來(C)輪流(D)四處看看。

questions.q:
Judy didn’t understand the meaning of the word “level” in the sentence below.
“... Our school library is on level four of the new building near the school gate. You can take the stairs to get there.” (building 建築物)
He looked it up in the dictionary and found more than one meaning. What does “level” mean here?
o: A floor in a large building.
questions.e: 我們的學校圖書館在新建大樓的四樓，由走樓梯可以到達推知 level 是「樓層」的意思，選(C)。

questions.q: When Jack told Nina to “look before you leap,” what did he want Nina to do?
o: To buy more and save more.
To think carefully before buying something.
To think about Jack before she buys anything.
To look for help if she wants to buy something.
questions.e: 根據對話內容可知，Nina 衝動購物，且中了飢餓行銷的陷阱，因此最後一句對話中 Jack 要她「做個聰明的購物者，別失去理智發瘋購物」，故可知最後一句話的意思是(B)購物前要三思。

questions.q: Amy went shopping, and four salespeople spoke to her. Who is NOT using “hungry marketing” tricks?
o: “This pot is from Japan. After you buy it, for the next two years, you can bring it back if it doesn’t work. We will fix it for you for free.”
“All the shoes here are buy one pair, get a pair FREE! TODAY ONLY!! Don’t miss this great chance because this is the last time of the year you can get this special deal!”
“Well, this dress is only for our VIP members but not for other people. Today you can pay just one thousand NT dollars to get it and become our VIP.”
“You won’t find anything better than this one at other stores. We are the only store selling it. If you don’t buy it, I am sure you will feel sorry later.”
questions.e: (A)選項的售貨人員向 Amy 說明該產品有保固，可以兩年內免費維修。(B)選項用「別錯過良機」、「今年最後一次」作為話術(C)選項說「這個產品本來只賣 VIP，但今天你可以用一千元購買產品並成為 VIP」為話術吸引顧客(D)選項以「別家買不到」、「絕無僅有」、「不買會後悔」為話術。故正解應為(A)。

questions.q: What can we NOT know from the reading?
o: People can visit Dream in Taiwan.
Zac lists the special place names from one to ten.
There are two place names about water in Michigan.
questions.e: 由文中無法得知 Zac 來自哪裡，故(A)錯誤。(B)由 Wendy 的留言可知 Dream 是在臺灣的一個地方(C)由表格可知 Zac 是由一到十排列美國特殊地名(D)由表格可知 Michigan 有 Three Rivers 和 Six Lakes 這兩個跟水有關的特殊地名。

questions.q: What is true about Hot Coffee in the reading?
o: It is in the north of the USA.
Many people visit it every year.
It is famous for its delicious coffee.
There may not be many people living there.
questions.e: 文中有提到 Hot Coffee 是很小的地方，只有幾間房子而已，故可推測應該不會有很多人住那裡，選(D)。(A)未提及在美國的哪裡(B)未提及是否有很多人拜訪(C)得名是因為那裡可以買到咖啡，且 Zac 說咖啡喝起來很普通，故不是因美味咖啡而有名。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT the “one” in the reading?
o: John: Bring your coffee to “Butter” Wisconsin. There you may try putting some butter in your coffee.
Vicky: I like cold coffee better than hot coffee, you know.
Jade: I went hiking in “Dollar Mountain” last year, but that doesn’t make me rich.
Peter: Well, I live in “Boring,” but I’m actually a funny guy!
questions.e: 由文中 Zac 分享有趣地名，並希望大家可以跟他分享世界各地有趣的地名，可知 one 是指有趣的地名，只有(B) Vicky 的留言跟地名無關。

questions.q: What do red, blue, and yellow mean in this poem?
questions.e: 文中提及這些顏色前，作者形容「像璀璨的星星在腦海中迸發，美麗似萬花筒般的思想…」，故答案選(C)。

questions.q: Which is the best title for the poem?
questions.e: 此文主要陳述作者在生命的旅程中尋找自我的喜悅和希望，故答案選(B)。

questions.q: Which area might Betty and Lya buy in the end?
questions.e: 因為 Lya 預算關係，超過新臺幣 4,000 元的不行，然後 Lya 提到超過新臺幣 3,500 元，她可以從自己的零用錢再拿新臺幣 300 元出來，表示選擇的區域是新臺幣 3,800 元的，符合此價錢又靠近舞臺的是(A) R1B。

questions.q: What can we know from the dialogue?
o: The time of the show is at noon.
Betty can get 20% off the ticket.
Lya’s mom may give her NT$3,500 for the ticket.
questions.e: Lya 有先提到媽媽不會給她那麼多錢，表示買票錢媽媽會出，後面又提到超過新臺幣 3,500 元，她可以從自己的零用錢再拿新臺幣 300 元出來，表示媽媽會給她的錢就是新臺幣 3,500 元，故選(D)。(A) Nick 應該是樂團成員(B)無法得知表演時間(C)無法得知 Betty 是否有符合折扣的條件。

questions.q: Jerry and his 66-year-old grandmother are big fans of the band, so he plans to take his grandmother to the show. He chose the seats in Y2A. How much did he pay in total?
questions.e: Y2A 的票價是新臺幣 2,800 元，奶奶有超過 65 歲可以打 8 折，故總價為新臺幣 2,800 元＋新臺幣 2,800 元×0.8＝新臺幣 5,040 元，選(C)。

questions.q: What may the “carriage” in the reading look like?
questions.e: carriage 用來解釋中文成語學富五車，而此句子是來自兩千年前，因此可推知兩千年前只會有(D)馬車，不會有飛機、跑車、潛水艇。

questions.q: On which website may we see the reading above?
o: Ways to make your own bamboo slips.
Funny stories from two thousand years ago.
questions.e: 此文章是在說明兩千多年前來的成語「學富五車」，若放到今日是否有什麼差別，因此比較可能會在(A)「跟中文成語相關的有趣事實」這個網站中看到此篇文章。

questions.q: What can we know from the reading?
o: There are about fifty words on one slip.
People need ropes to make a roll of bamboo slips.
Bamboo slips were cheaper than paper two thousand years ago.
Five carriages of books two thousand years ago have as many words as a heavy book does today.
questions.e: 由圖片可知竹簡會用細繩綁成一卷，故(B)正確。(A)未提到一片竹簡上有幾個字(C)未提到兩千年前竹簡跟紙的價錢比較(D)「五車」的竹簡書無法填滿一個書桌上的大箱子，不是約等於一本厚重的書。

questions.q: Look at the picture (Cloud A → Cloud B → Cloud C, from LOW DENSITY to HIGH DENSITY). Which is the correct order to show the density of clouds, from low to high?
o: Cloud A: cirrus clouds／Cloud B: cumulus clouds／Cloud C: cumulonimbus clouds
Cloud A: cirrus clouds／Cloud B: cumulonimbus clouds／Cloud C: cumulus clouds
Cloud A: cumulus clouds／Cloud B: cirrus clouds／Cloud C: cumulonimbus clouds
Cloud A: cumulus clouds／Cloud B: cumulonimbus clouds／Cloud C: cirrus clouds
questions.e: 雲的含水量越高則密度越高，cirrus clouds（卷雲）在晴天可見，其含水量最低，cumulus clouds（積雲）含水量其次，cumulonimbus clouds（積雨雲）含水量最高，故選(A)。

questions.q: Which picture shows the correct way to know the size of a cloud?
questions.e: 當太陽在雲的正上方時，我們可以透過駕車穿越過雲層的影子來知道雲的大小尺寸，所以(A)為正確方式。

questions.q: Which is true about clouds from the reading?
o: A cumulus cloud is heavier than 1.1 million elephants.
Clouds are as light as air, so they can stay up in the sky.
The water in a cloud is less heavy than the air around it.
By using a tool, people can know the density of a cloud.
questions.e: 由本文可知(C)雲中的水的重量並不如它周圍的空氣那麼重，故(C)為正確選項。其他選項皆有誤：(A)一朵積雲大約和一百隻大象一樣重(B)雲比空氣輕，所以它們可以停留在空中(D)文中沒有提到人們可以藉由使用器具來得知雲的密度。

questions.q: If staying up late has a “bad effect” on people, what may happen?
o: They may sleep better the next day.
They may get a day off the next day.
They may have a good time with friends.
They may look terrible the next morning.
questions.e: 文中 bad effect 後面提到是工作表現不佳與和人無法相處融洽，皆是負面的情況，故可推知熬夜會有的 bad effect 應該是(D)隔天早上看起來很糟。

questions.q: What can we know from the reading?
o: Most young carers don’t like their life at school.
The USA has the most young carers in the world.
The writer thinks the government should take action to help.
Sean stopped school because he had to take care of his mom.
questions.e: 最後一段作者提到政府應及時提供援助，故(C)正確。(A)無法得知年輕照顧者喜不喜歡學校生活(B)從圖表只能知道美國年輕照顧者數量多於澳洲及英國，並無法得知是否是全世界最多(D)是 Sean 的姐姐們停學。

questions.q: Who may also be a young carer?
o: Leo often sleeps in class. His teacher is worried and asks him not to stay up playing video games.
Lucy lost all her family in a big fire. She has no one to count on, so she has to stay in a children’s home.
Nancy can’t join the school party at night. Every day after school, she has to go home to take care of her 90-year-old grandmother.
Mike is studying in his dream high school. However, he will move to another country next year because his father just got a job there.
questions.e: 年輕照護者的定義，由 Sean 的例子可知是年紀輕輕還在讀書，就得幫忙照顧家人，符合此狀況的為(C)的 Nancy，她必須放學後照顧年邁的奶奶。

questions.q: 第 41 格應填入：
o: pick any two parts of their body
take as much money as they wanted
get a lot of money later when they got home
questions.e: 由後面的兩處之間每一吋的價錢，及第一位士兵挑選身體的頭頂到腳底，可知是他們可以(B)挑選身體上任何兩個地方。

questions.q: 第 42 格應填入：
o: the top of his head and the tip of his big toe
his left ear and the top of his right middle finger
the tip of his big toe and the tip of his middle finger
the tip of his left middle finger and the tip of his right one
questions.e: 由後面描述士兵踮起腳尖並把手伸高過頭的動作，可推知他選的是(C)大拇趾到中指尖。

questions.q: 第 43 格應填入：
o: Where did you get the shoes?
How long are your two big toes?
Why did you take off your shoes?
questions.e: 由軍官驚訝的口氣，及士兵回答它在日本，可推知是軍官沒有看到士兵的腳趾頭，才會問(A)你的右腳大拇趾在哪裡？
